# Hyaecord

> Hyaecord is a performance-focused, native-feeling, open-source (GPL-3.0) Discord desktop client for Linux (primary) and Windows. It is an original client — not a fork of Discord, Equicord, or Vencord — that implements a compatibility layer so most Equicord and Vencord plugins run unmodified. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord Inc.

Key facts:
- License: source code GPL-3.0; the Hyaecord name/logo/branding are all rights reserved and governed by a separate trademark policy. Forks are always allowed under the GPL but must rebrand.
- Contains no automation, self-bot, spam, or scraping functionality; such features are permanently out of scope by policy.
- Telemetry: one anonymous daily ping (random ID, app version, OS, desktop environment — never linked to a Discord account), disclosed in the first-run wizard, with a one-click opt-out in Settings. The website sets no cookies and runs no analytics.
- Third-party client modifications are against Discord's Terms of Service; the project discloses this prominently.
- Packaging: Flatpak (org.hyaecord.Hyaecord), AppImage, .deb, .rpm, AUR (hyaecord-bin / hyaecord-git).

## Docs

- [Project wiki](https://github.com/Hyaecord/hyaecord/wiki): user and developer documentation

- [Plugin Guidelines](https://github.com/Hyaecord/hyaecord/blob/main/PLUGIN_GUIDELINES.md): plugin rules — no paywalls, open source, no abuse
- [Trademark & Branding Policy](https://github.com/Hyaecord/hyaecord/blob/main/TRADEMARK.md): what the GPL covers vs. the brand
